limitations: This is a dimension/photo reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD. The inspected complete fixed repository tree and canonical resources did not expose CAD, but this bounded search is not a claim that no official CAD exists elsewhere.

SKU35471 includes a separate lithium battery; SKU35356 (-EN) omits it. This model shows the documented bare board/display assembly only. Battery, external speaker, cable and battery mounting are not reconstructed.

Official shop and docs dimension images disagree: PCB37.13×29.84 versus37.12×29.83 mm, and side reference6.70 versus6.40 mm. Both unchanged sources remain available. The rendered6.55 mm reference is explicitly their midpoint, not a measured value.

Both sources agree on glass41.13×33.13 and AA32.63×27.97 mm in their landscape drawing. The model uses a rigid portrait arrangement, preserving the dimensions; rounded corners clip normalized framebuffer UVs without stretching.

Glass, AA and PCB corner radii are visual estimates. The shop drawing4×R1.00 callout is retained but its local feature identity is not certified, so it is not repurposed as a global PCB or display corner radius.

PCB thickness, internal face, traces, laminate, component heights, small passives and connector contacts are UNKNOWN or simplified. The inner PCB is labeled UNKNOWN and exposed by inspection. Rear component photographs show appearance without certifying PCB revision or hidden geometry.
The curved glass edge is simplified as a constant-thickness rounded plate; no optical refraction or exact edge curvature is claimed.
Only BOOT is bound to runtime input boot, GPIO28 active-low. RESET remains geometry only; PWR is through TCA EX4 and is not exposed as a fictitious ordinary GPIO button.
Official front imagery is a reference only. Its displayed UI is not used as a runtime texture or claimed as simulated framebuffer output.
Optical text-to-USB orientation has not been physically calibrated. Runtime frame shape240×280 is preserved; the chosen model orientation does not certify viewing-angle or touch-to-glass alignment.
The0.008 mm live-screen offset avoids rendering overlap and is not a physical layer thickness.
Repository commit timestamps are source timestamps, not evidence of device release date. No lost pre-reset model or acceptance result is reused.

sourceSearch.result: No matching mechanical file in the complete fixed tree and no CAD link on the inspected canonical resource page. Official dimensional, straight rear and side photographs support a bounded reconstruction. Temporary search failures are not treated as evidence of absence.

rear.scope: Approximate orthographic registration, checked against both nominal cover axes. The unchanged rear image is projected onto the estimated board and selected envelope tops; no claim of metrology or exact perspective correction.

cornerRadiusEstimates.basis: Visual tangent positions on 800×800 official imagery; image display content is illustrative, so these estimates remain independent of exact physical AA dimensions.
